Aegisthus: lover of Clytemnestra and king of Mycenae in Greek myth
Agamemnon: king of Mycenae and commander of the Achaeans in the Trojan War
Amphimachus: Mycenaean prince of Greek mythology
Astymedusa: Mycenaean princess in Greek mythology
Atreus: king of Mycenae, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus
Chrysothemis: princess of Mycenae, daughter of Agamemnon
Clytemnestra: queen of Mycenae, wife of Agamemnon
Electryon: king of Mycenae, son of Perseus and father of Alcmene
Elias Magnus Fries: Swedish mycologist and botanist, known as the "Linnaeus of Mycology"
Eurydice of Mycenae: daughter of Pelops and wife of Electryon, king of Mycenae
Eurystheus: king of Mycenae in Greek mythology, master of Heracles' twelve labours
Gorgophonus: Mycenaean prince in Greek mythology
Sthenelus: Greek hero, king of Mycenae and son of Perseus
Stratobates: Mycenaean prince, son of Electryon
Thyestes: king of Mycenae, brother of Atreus in Greek myth
